Login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: A project groups its members, knowledge bases, agents and usage. Create one per team or use case.
Projects.emptyBody: Create the first project, then add members and assign providers to it.

Members.title: Project members
Members.description: A member's role decides which screens they see; the access mode decides whether they can change things.

Members.noCandidates: Every active user is already a member of this project.

Providers.title: Providers
Providers.description: A provider is a model endpoint such as LLMaaS or a local runtime. Test the connection and assign it to projects.

Providers.label: Name

Providers.keyInvalid: Use 2-64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.

Providers.projectsHint: A provider is always assigned to at least one project.
Providers.secretStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
Providers.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {label}? Its models stop being served.

Models.emptyBody: This project has no models yet. Add one from a provider assigned to the project.
Models.name: Name

Models.addNeedsSuperadmin: Adding a model needs a superadmin until providers are listed per project.
Models.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 2-64 characters. Part of the LiteLLM name; it cannot be changed later.

KnowledgeBases.title: Knowledge bases
KnowledgeBases.description: Documents the agents search. Upload files, see what each quality gate decided and try a search.
KnowledgeBases.emptyBody: Create a knowledge base first, then upload documents to it.
KnowledgeBases.needsAdmin: Only a project admin can create, change or delete knowledge bases.
KnowledgeBases.name: Name
KnowledgeBases.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (2-64). It cannot be changed later.
KnowledgeBases.keyInvalid: Use 2-64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
KnowledgeBases.chunkSizeHint: Minimum chunk length; the measured default is 400.
KnowledgeBases.chunkOverlapHint: Tokens repeated between chunks; the measured default is 0.
KnowledgeBases.minScoreHint: Used only when the reranker is off. With the reranker on, only the rerank floor applies (one threshold).
KnowledgeBases.deleteConfirm: Delete the knowledge base "{name}"? Its documents leave search at once.

SystemStatus.description: Whether the installation can serve: models loaded, configuration consistent, vector store reachable.

Tools.title: Tools
Tools.description: MCP and OpenAPI servers the agents can call. Register a server, discover its actions, then choose which actions are on and which need an approval.
Tools.needsAdmin: Only a project admin can register or change tools.
Tools.emptyBody: Register an MCP server to give agents actions such as searching documents or running SQL.
Tools.name: Name
Tools.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; the model sees each action as key__action.
Tools.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
Tools.endpointHint: Scheme, host, port and path only. No user name, password or query string.

authHints.none: The tool is called without credentials.
authHints.header: Sent as one header of your choice; transport and identity headers are refused.
authHints.forward_user: The caller's identity as a short-lived signed token; only for internal FFCore services.

Tools.secretKept: The stored credentials are kept. Choose the type again or type new values to replace them.
Tools.deleteConfirm: Delete the tool “{name}”? Agents that use it will fail to save until it is removed from them.
Tools.discovered: {count, plural, one {# action found} other {# actions found}}

Tools.noActionsBody: Run “Discover actions” to read the actions the server offers.
Tools.argumentsInvalid: Enter a JSON object (an empty object is fine).
Tools.truncated: Shortened; the full answer has {total} characters.

Agents.title: Agents
Agents.description: Assistants built from a model, instructions, knowledge bases and tools. Build one in the wizard, try it in the test panel, then publish.

Agents.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; used in the name agent:project/key.
Agents.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter.
Agents.modelHint: A chat model of this project.

Agents.deleteConfirm: Delete the agent “{name}”? Its runs stay in the run history.

wizard.systemPromptHint: Write a variable's key in double braces to insert its value.

wizard.langfuseHint: The name of the prompt in Langfuse.

knowledgeModes.toolHint: Offered to the model as search_documents.

wizard.unknownReply: Answer when the documents do not know

Evaluations.title: Evaluations
Evaluations.description: An exam suite runs a set of questions against an agent version and scores the answers. A suite bound to an agent gates its publishing.
Evaluations.emptyBody: Create a suite, then add questions to it from a completed run ("Add to exam") or in Langfuse.
Evaluations.name: Suite
Evaluations.suiteDescription: Settings, exam start and the exams of this suite.
Evaluations.itemsHint: The questions are kept in this Langfuse dataset. Add one from a completed run ("Add to exam" on the run page) or import them in Langfuse.

form.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; cannot be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.agentHint: Publishing a version of this agent needs a passed, complete exam of this suite. Leave empty for no gate.
form.datasetHint: Leave empty for {prefix} followed by the key. A name of your own must start with {prefix}
form.datasetFixed: The dataset cannot be changed after the suite is created.
form.scorersHint: Choose at least one. Deterministic scorers come first; the LLM judge is secondary.
form.passThresholdHint: Share of scored items that must pass (0-1). Empty: the installation default.

errors.repeatRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.
errors.passMinRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 5.
errors.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (starting with a letter or digit).

start.title: Start an exam
start.hint: Every item of the dataset runs against the chosen version in the background. It may take long; progress shows live.
start.versionHint: Default: the draft when there is one (the exam before publishing), else the published version.
